newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Zale Corp started as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Zale Corp started as a buy.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of Zale Corp with a buy rating and a target price of $27.

-- The recommendation is based on several factors that took place after the company filed for bankruptcy in January of 1992, including the closing of 671 underperforming stores and a renegotiation of the remaining leases, Rodman said.
-- Rodman also cited management changes since Zale emerged from bankruptcy in July of 1993 and lower debt levels.
-- Rodman added there is still significant progress to be made in divisions other than the Zales stores.
-- Zales operates specialty fine jewelry stores.
-- Its shares were trading up 5/8 Tuesday at 19.
